text:
Priya: Quick sync — need us to pick GA approach: all-products GA (Hosted + Dedicated) vs Hosted-first.
Dan: Hosted-first. lower operational risk.
Eli: Hosted-first plus model-class SLOs. Agree.
Maya: If Hosted-first, we need an enterprise FAQ and a clear timeline for Dedicated.
Priya: Draft minimal GA promises:
```
- Hosted: supported models, published rate limits, public pricing
- SLA: hosted best-effort; Dedicated SLA = post-GA commitment
- Monitoring: traces, model-level p95, route error alerts
- Support: business-hours + escalation templates
- Docs: Quickstart, Admin, Enterprise FAQ
- Pricing: hosted list; Dedicated = contact sales
```
Dan: Proposed SLOs by class: small p95 < 120ms, medium < 250ms, large < 600ms. Error rate <0.5% overall.
Eli: Add fallback routing and degrade plan in case of load spikes.
ops-bot: FYI oncall capacity: cannot guarantee 24/7 Dedicated support until 2025-01-15.
Priya: Consensus: ship Hosted GA with limited SLA; push Dedicated SLA and 24/7 to post-GA. Owners: Docs=Maya, Monitoring=Eli, SLA wording=Dan, SRE signoff=ops-bot.
Maya: I'll start the FAQ draft and ops playbook.
Eli: I'll build the dashboard templates and SLO buckets.
Priya: I'll make the shiproom one-pager and update launch board. Exec readout set for 09:30 tomorrow.
Dan: :thumbsup:
